description.value:
The Force strengthens your body directly, granting you the following benefits:

  • Your hit point maximum increases by 3, plus another 1 each time you gain a level in this class.
  • Your base AC becomes 13 plus your Constitution modifier.
  • When a force power you cast requires a melee weapon attack, you may use Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) in place of Strength for both the attack and damage rolls.

Additionally, as an action you can gain resistance to kinetic and energy damage for 1 minute. This resistance ends early if you end it as a bonus action, become incapacitated, or don armor other than a shield. You can use this feature twice, regaining all uses after a short or long rest.
